import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables, ignoring the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join df0 and df1 on the 'Athlete' column (inner join)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Athlete", how="inner")

# Convert columns to target schema types

# 'Athlete' - string
df_joined['Athlete'] = df_joined['Athlete'].astype(str)

# 'Age' - float
df_joined['Age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Age'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'Year' - integer (nullable Int64)
df_joined['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# 'Closing Ceremony Date' - string
df_joined['Closing Ceremony Date'] = df_joined['Closing Ceremony Date'].astype(str)

# 'Gold Medals' - integer (nullable Int64)
df_joined['Gold Medals'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Gold Medals'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# 'Silver Medals' - integer (nullable Int64)
df_joined['Silver Medals'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Silver Medals'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# 'Bronze Medals' - integer (nullable Int64)
df_joined['Bronze Medals'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Bronze Medals'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# 'Total Medals' - integer (nullable Int64)
df_joined['Total Medals'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['Total Medals'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# 'Country' - string
df_joined['Country'] = df_joined['Country'].astype(str)

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Athlete',
    'Age',
    'Year',
    'Closing Ceremony Date',
    'Gold Medals',
    'Silver Medals',
    'Bronze Medals',
    'Total Medals',
    'Country'
]

df_target = df_joined[target_columns]

# Write the transformed data to the output CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
